plan.analysis: Misses are dominated by the small-size tertile in every class (inclusion low-tertile recall 0.034, patches 0.344, scratches 0.338) and by low contrast. Missed medians (37/51/42 px) are far below train medians (90/85/73 px), so the model simply has not seen small defects. Inclusion is the weakest class (recall 0.19, 158/179 missed; thin faint vertical streaks and dots). Scratches also show low precision (0.47, 0.22 FP/img) and miss thin short lines. Patches are healthiest but still miss small dark blobs. No prior rounds, so start from the size gap.
plan.rationale: Redirect synthetic mass to the small-defect regime the model misses: prefer_small sources plus sub-1.0 scales yield pastes near the missed sizes (inclusion 0.3-1.0 also covers the weak mid tertile). Inclusion gets the largest share (20) as the worst class, with sources chosen to match the missed thin streaks/dots (excluding the bright-on-white 287 and blob-like 99). Patches and scratches get 15 each to lift small-defect recall without starving the shared detector; any_class backgrounds add texture diversity.

plan.analysis: Preview confirms the plan: inclusion pastes are thin faint streaks (small scale) matching the missed thin streaks/dots; patches are compact dark blobs at small scale matching missed small patches; scratches are thin lines at small scale matching missed thin lines. Sizes land in the small tertile the model misses; looks are realistic. No revision needed.
plan.rationale: Preview pastes look right in size and appearance for all three classes and target the small-defect gap. Inclusion gets the largest share (20) as the worst class with sources matching the missed thin streaks/dots; patches and scratches get 15 each to lift small-defect recall without starving the shared detector. Keeping the same plan.
